text: Shining daughter of Time and Night, the fifty [months have brought] you, sixteenth day of the month at Olympia by the will of to judge the speed of swift feet and preeminence in strength of limbs among the Greeks. The one to whom you give the most distinguished honor of victory is called glorious and much envied among men. You have adorned with garlands [the son] of Aristomenes, Lachon
